contents.contents: Excerpts on the incarnation of Christ from the works of Theodore bar Koni, fol. 2r-25v; excerpts from the book of Rabban Yōnān from the Tḥūmā district, fol. 25v-31v; excerpts from the works of Michael Badoqa, fol. 31v-32v; excerpts from the commentaries of Ishōʻdād of Merv, fol. 32v-48v; ‘Onyāthā on the economy of our Savior excerpted from the books of prayer, fol. 49v-50r; excerpts from the metrical homilies of Narsai, fol. 50v-56v; excerpts from Book of the main events by Yoḥannan bar Penqaye, fol. 56v-58v; excerpts mainly taken from the writings of Greek and Latin Church Fathers, including Athanasius the Great, Pope Damasus, Gregory of Nyssa, Basil of Caesarea, Amphilochius of Iconium, Proclus of Constantinople, John Chrysostom, Severianus of Gabala, and Sophronius of Jerusalem, with excerpt from a metrical homily by Ephrem the Syrian, fol. 58v-65v; excerpts from Delightful meadows by Ya‘qob Awgen Manna, fol. 66v-67r
contents.notes: Fol. 84v-85r comprise the same content as fol. 66v-67r; from the middle colophon it seems that the compiler is Mar Timotheos, Metropolitan of Malabar and India

contents.contents: Preparation prayers for Nativity (ܐܣܬܥܕܐܕ ܐܠܡܝܠܐܕ), fol. 1r-9v; rite for Nativity (ܐܠܣܓܕܗ̈ ܒܥܕ ܥܝܕ ܐܠܡܝܠܐܕ), fol. 10rv; rite of Epiphany (ܬܟܪܝܣ ܐܠܡܐܝ ܦܝ ܥܝܕ ܐܠܕܢܚ), fol. 10v-17r; rite for the consecration of candles (ܬܒܪܝܟ ܐܠܫܡܥ), fol. 17r-24v; rite for the consecration of the ash (ܬܒܪܝܟ ܐܠܪܡܐܕ), fol. 24v-32r; prayer for the Fridays of Lent (ܡܢܚ ܐܠܒܪܟܗ̈ ܒܐܠܨܠܝܒ), fol. 32r-36r; rite for Palm Sunday (ܬܒܪܝܟ ܐܥ݁ܨܐܢ ܐܠܫܥܐܢܝܢ), fol. 36r-45v; rite for Holy Thursday (ܐܠܜܣܠ ܦܝ ܝܘܡ ܟܡܝܣ ܐܠܐܣܪܐܪ), fol. 45v-60v; rite for Good Friday (ܣܓܕܗ̈ ܐܠܨܠܝܒ), fol. 60v-73r; rite for Holy Saturday (ܨܠܘܗ̈ ܐܠܥ݀ܦܪܐܢ), fol. 73rv; rite for Glorious Resurrection (ܨܠܘܗ̈ ܐܠܣܠܐܡ ܦܝ ܐܚܕ ܐܠܦܨܚ), fol. 73v-82v; rite for Pentecost (ܐܠܣܓܕܗ̈ ܦܝ ܐܚܕ ܐܠܒܢܕܝܟܘܣܬܝ), fol. 83r-98r; rite of betrothal (ܐܠܟܛܒܗ̈), fol. 98r-101r; rite of marriage (ܬܟܠܝܠ ܐܠܥܪܣܐܢ ܐܠܐܥܙܐܒ), fol. 101r-111r; marriage of widows (ܬܟܠܝܠ ܐܠܐܪܐܡܠ), fol. 111r-113r; two rites of baptism (ܐܠܥܡܐܕ), fol. 113r-125v; rites for woman who has given birth (ܥܠܝ ܐܠܘܐܠܕܗ̈ ܘܐܠܒܝܬ), fol. 125v-130r; rite of anointing of the sick and last rites (ܡܣܚܗ̈ ܐܠܡܪܨ݀ܝ ܘܐܠܡܢܐܙܥܝܢ), fol. 130v-149r; Rosary prayers and litany (ܡܢܚ ܐܠܒܪܟܗ̈ ܒܐܝܩܘܢܗ̈ ܐܠܘܪܕܝܗ̈), fol. 149r-164v; Saint Maron's prayers and litany (ܡܢܚ ܐܠܒܪܟܗ̈ ܒܐܝܩܘܢܗ̈ ܐܒܝܢܐ ܡܐܪܘܢ), fol. 164v-170r; procession for Corpus Christi (ܙܝܐܚ ܐܠܩܪܒܐܢ ܝܘܡ ܥܝܕ ܐܠܓܣܕ), fol. 170r-176v; membership in the brotherhood of the Rosary (ܣܝܐܡܗ̈ ܡܢ ܝܫܬܪܟ ܦܝ ܐܟܘܝܗ̈ ܐܠܘܪܕܝܗ̈), fol. 176v-185r; blessing of the water for the feast of Saints Peter and Paul (ܬܒܪܝܟ ܐܠܡܐܝ ܦܝ ܥܝܕ ܡܐܪܝ ܒܛܪܣ ܘܒܘܠܣ), fol. 185v-195r; glorification of the Cross (ܙܝܐܚ ܐܠܨܠܝܒ ܐܠܡܩܕܣ), fol. 195r-209r; rite for the sick (ܐܠܩܢܕܝܠ), fol. 209v-224v
